SELECT
	itemname=A.itemname,
	packing=A.packing,
	manufacurer=A.manufacurer,
	looseqty=Sum(A.looseqty),
	price=max(A.price),
	tax = SUM(A.Tax),
	id=max(A.id),
	 cumulativesum = round(0.00,2),
	 cumulativesumfoot = round(0.00,2)
	
	FROM

	(	SELECT itemname = item.name, 
					 packing = dbo.item.packingdesc,
					 manufacurer = (dbo.manufacturer.name),
					 looseqty = Sum (dbo.saledetail.looseqty),
					 price = max(dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 
					 tax = SUM(dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01) * (dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01)) + SUM((dbo.saledetail.looseqty + dbo.saledetail.bonusqty) * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax),
					 id = max(dbo.saledetail.rowid),
					icode=saledetail.icode
					
			FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
					 dbo.saledetail,    
					 dbo.item, 
					 dbo.Customer,
					 dbo.Accounts,
					 dbo.Manufacturer 
			WHERE  
					CASE lower(:as_doctype) 
							When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
							When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
							When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate END >= :ad_StartDate AND
					 CASE lower(:as_doctype) 
							When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
							When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
							When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate  END  <= :ad_EndDate  AND 
					 dbo.saleledger.custcode IN ( :al_custcode ) AND
					 dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
					 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
					 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode AND
					 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
					 dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
					 dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode
			Group by 
					dbo.saledetail.icode,
					dbo.item.name,
					dbo.item.packingdesc,
					dbo.manufacturer.name
			UNION ALL
			SELECT itemname = item.name,
					 packing = dbo.item.packingdesc,
					 manufacurer = (dbo.manufacturer.name),
					 looseqty = Sum (sd.looseqty),
					 price = max(sd.saleprice),    
					 tax = ROUND(SUM(sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (sd.gstperc * 0.01)) + SUM((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * sd.unitsalestax), 2),
					 id = max(sd.rowid),
					icode=sd.icode
					
			FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
					 dbo.saleinvdetail sd,    
					 dbo.item, 
					 dbo.Customer,
					 dbo.Accounts,
					 dbo.Manufacturer 
			WHERE  
					
					dbo.saleledger.impactinventory = 'N' AND
					CASE lower(:as_doctype) 
							When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
							When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
							When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate END >= :ad_StartDate AND
					 CASE lower(:as_doctype) 
							When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
							When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
							When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate  END  <= :ad_EndDate  AND 
					 dbo.saleledger.custcode IN ( :al_custcode ) AND
					 dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
					 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
					 sd.icode = item.icode AND
					 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
					 dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
					 dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode
			Group by 
					sd.icode,
					dbo.item.name,
					dbo.item.packingdesc,
					dbo.manufacturer.name )AS A
			

GROUP BY
			A.icode,
			A.itemname,
			A.packing,
			A.manufacurer
ORDER BY 
			A.itemname
